comparisons.title: Independent verification: all orthogonal chart phase defects and equal fibers
comparisons.head: 1782d916e7a230ae12bd64a290aac398cfc4e971
comparisons.author: mightyOil
comparisons.overlap: The written all-dimension phase-defect spectrum uses the classical involution T_v(x)=x+(v dot x)v, factors orthogonal rebases and counts defect fibers. Its package has no Lean source in the changed-file list.
comparisons.distinction_and_reuse: This is genuine algebraic transvection overlap, which must not be advertised as new mathematics. The new Lean checker allows an explicit functional form with f(u)=0 and checked serialized columns, constructs the map/inverse, and joins strict parsing; it does not classify complex phase defects. Credit Philipp/mightyOil and its explicit PR1255 lineage.
